title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Coliseum on 1982-04-12

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording of a high‑energy spring ’82 show featuring smoking Peggy‑O, Bird Song, Sugaree and Stella
ai_review.review: The performance shines with lyrical Jerry solos, soaring vocals on Peggy‑O and Bird Song, and tight interplay throughout the second set – especially on Sugaree, Estimated and Stella. The audience tape captures a vibrant crowd and surprisingly clear stereo dynamics, despite a slightly low bass presence. Overall the show is rated as one of the standout East‑coast dates of 1982.

ai_rating.rationale: Overwhelmingly positive comments on both musical performance and recording quality; only minor technical complaints and one low‑star outlier.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear stereo dynamics, crisp overall sound; bass a bit low but no major dropouts or distortion. Reviewers repeatedly call it superb for an audience tape.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set builds with fun Iko, sweet Peggy‑O and a tight LL Rain>Deal; the second set gains momentum with soaring Sugaree, inventive Estimated and an epic Stella, culminating in a rocking Satisfaction encore.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for lyrical solos, beautiful tone, expressive vocals on Peggy‑O and Bird Song; described as sprightly and light‑touched.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted for dropping bass bombs, powerful low‑end that “punches” despite being a bit low in the mix.
band_member_comments.Bob: Vocals on Estimated highlighted as terrific without showboating; vocal interruptions on The Other One add character.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent Mydland lauded for professional keyboard work and vocal support, especially locked with Jerry during Bird Song.
band_member_comments.Drums: Both drummers described as locked in from the outset, providing a solid rhythmic foundation captured well by the audience recording.
